svg.text: Five frozen patient folds: each fold held out once
Train on three folds; validate on one
Three seeds; inner-derived duration; no outer validation
Repeat for all five outer folds
After all folds finish: join target labels
Pool outer OOF predictions separately for each method and seed
Evaluate ViT, Swin and the inner-selected procedure
All images from a patient stay together. Primary reference: fixed modal-low. Official test partition excluded.
Metrics: mean ± sample SD across three seeds, not a prediction ensemble. OOF = out-of-fold.
